provenance.source_label: Feedback from ChatGPT: MKTCTX/3: this is a real format
provenance.review_target: A reported 6.3 MB, 137715-line MKTCTX/3 packet with 396 indexed files; exact artifact not identified

claims: The reviewer reported reconstructing every indexed file and resolving every alias.
The reviewer reported that reconstructed bytes, source line counts, and SHA-256 hashes matched for all 370 exact files.
The reviewer reported that all 26 remaining files were explicit byte-identical aliases.
The reviewer inferred the path-derived file ID and manifest-derived packet ID algorithms from the packet and reported verifying them.

positive_findings: The versioned magic, packet identity, root, file count, generator and analyzer versions, selection semantics, completeness posture, and manifest integrity made the packet self-describing.
The source-as-data trust boundary was clear and usefully repeated locally on content envelopes and chunks.
The packet was epistemically honest about incomplete selection, incomplete repository coverage, 46 missing selected paths, and unavailable module edges.
Path identity, packet identity, and content identity were cleanly separated.
Explicit byte-identical aliases reduced bytes without collapsing distinct resources.
Line-oriented controls plus directly readable source avoided JSON escaping noise while retaining machine framing.
reviewer_characterization: A content-addressed, citation-addressable repository transport format with structural indexes and an explicit LLM trust boundary.
tar plus ctags plus provenance plus prompt-injection hygiene, designed for model consumption.
A credible context interchange format rather than merely a repository-pasting convenience.
reviewer_priority: The reviewer recommends prioritizing VCS and diff semantics plus a formal normative grammar before adding another projection feature.

available_evidence: The complete review text was relayed by the user.
The repository contains production renderer, parser, unit tests, and adversarial fixtures for MKTCTX/3.
limitations: The reviewer's parser source, command transcript, packet bytes, and computed digest report were not supplied.
The exact reviewed packet was not identified, so the reported 396-file result cannot be reproduced from this intake artifact alone.
